Teacher Svein:
An evolved Spirit's power can be extracted. It condenses in the process turning into an Attribute Fragment.
If you extract a Fire Spirit's power, you will get a Fire Attribute Fragment, while a Wind Spirit will provide you with a Wind Attribute Fragment, and so on.
To extract an Attribute Fragment, you must pay a small fee. It can be done by opening the Extraction tab in the 'Attribute Spirits' UI.
Extracted fragments can imbue various items with the Sprit's power. I can tell you more if you are interested.
(Note that an Attribute Fragment extraction decreases your Spirit's level to 1. Please keep that in mind.)
